"""Refunds, credits and manual adjustments made by the support team (moved over from the old billing monolith)."""

from . import audit
from .clock import ensure_utc
from .errors import BillingError
from .invoice import invoice_total
from .money import ZERO, round_money, to_money


def manual_adjustment(invoice, amount, note):
    if invoice.status not in ("issued", "paid"):
        raise ValueError("can only adjust issued or paid invoices")
    if not note:
        raise ValueError("a note is required")
    return {"invoice_id": invoice.id, "amount": amount, "note": note}

def adjustable_balance(invoice) -> float:
    return float(invoice_total(invoice))

def outage_refund(payment, amount, at):
    """Refund part of a captured payment after a service outage."""
    amount = round_money(amount)
    if amount <= ZERO:
        raise BillingError("non_positive_amount", str(amount))
    if payment.status != "captured":
        raise BillingError("invalid_state", f"payment {payment.id} is {payment.status}")
    refunded = to_money(payment.refunded_amount)
    if refunded + amount > to_money(payment.amount):
        raise BillingError("refund_exceeds_captured", str(amount))
    ensure_utc(at)
    payment.refunded_amount = refunded + amount
    if payment.refunded_amount >= to_money(payment.amount):
        payment.status = "refunded"
    audit.record("payment_refunded", payment_id=payment.id, amount=amount)
    return payment

import pytest

def mk(amt="2000.00"): return Payment("p","i",Decimal(amt),status="captured",created_at=T0,captured_at=T0)

# at threshold no approval
p=mk(); outage_refund(p, Decimal("1000.00"), T0); print("threshold ok", p.refunded_amount)
# above threshold requires approval
p=mk()
try: outage_refund(p, Decimal("1000.01"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("approval:", e.code)
# with approval
p=mk(); outage_refund(p, Decimal("1000.01"), T0, approved_by="mgr"); print("approved", p.refunded_amount)
# full refund sets status
p=mk("10.00"); outage_refund(p, Decimal("10.00"), T0); print("status", p.status)
# non-captured
p=mk(); p.status="authorized"
try: outage_refund(p, Decimal("1.00"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("state:", e.code)
# exceeds
p=mk("10.00")
try: outage_refund(p, Decimal("11.00"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("exceeds:", e.code)
# non-positive
p=mk()
try: outage_refund(p, Decimal("0"), T0)
except BillingError as e: print("nonpos:", e.code)
EOF
